The '''Ayceezee Public College''' was a school located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> former [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Voort saBinring]] taught mathematics in the school.<ref name="MK" />
